text:
elisabeth: Quick sync — Harpoon tenant cutover is scheduled for TOMORROW 15:00 UTC. Who's on final owners for network / registry / smoke? Any last-minute blockers we need on the runbook?
ramez: registry mirror still at ~76% — we hit a blob verify error during the last rsync. Putting it here in case netops needs to open a ticket with the customer host. :warning:
aj: I opened PR #482 to add the mirror fallback logic (ttl + alternate-host header). Can review but need a second set of eyes on the token refresh codepath. ETA 2h.
sophie: On the customer's side the internal CA bundle is missing the intermediary cert we require for our image signatures. They said their ops will patch today but haven't confirmed yet. Without that images won't verify in the airgapped kube nodes.
leo: ran a quick probe from staging-prober -> mirror: `curl -I https://mirror.harpoon.internal/v2/` shows 503 and `x-sync-error: blob-checksum-mismatch` in headers. Pasting output:\n```\nHTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable\nx-sync-error: blob-checksum-mismatch\ncontent-type: text/plain\n```\nops-bot: Canary build job #harpoon-reg-sync failed (step: verify-blobs). See https://ci.redwood/integrations/harpoon/1234 :robot_face:
qa: Who's owning the preflight smoke list? We need the ordered checklist: registry, certs, iptables, nfs mounts, canary-model load test. I can run the smoke once owners are declared.
devex: runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/private-deployments/harpoon — added a note about mirror fallback and how to flip to hosted fallback.
elisabeth: Owner matrix draft: network -> sophie, registry sync -> ramez + aj, smoke/QA -> qa, oncall fallback -> leo. If anyone disagrees speak now. :eyes:
ramez: Agree on owners. For the blob checksum problem, I suspect the mirror sync tool (s3sync v0.9) and the customer's storage endpoint have differing MD5 calculation for chunked uploads. Asking them to re-run a full resync with `--disable-chunked` as a workaround.
aj: I'll prioritize PR review and add a short healthcheck after token refresh so we fail fast. If I can't finish in 2h I'll ping @elisabeth.
sophie: Net team — can you confirm the customer's firewall allows outbound to our mirror proxy at 3.120.45.18:443 and that their egress NAT preserves source port? We saw earlier NAT rewriting broke keepalives. Also they need the intermediary cert patched.
leo: If the mirror can't be fixed in time we have a mitigation: run a temporary local registry on the customer's airgapped control plane and push the required images (we already have prebuilt tarballs). That will buy ~3 hours for registry fixes but needs Ops help for kubeadm image load.
qa: I can queue the smoke run after registry is green. My tests will take ~18 minutes (health, small-latency trace, simple generator p95).
elisabeth: Action items summarized: 1) ramez -> coordinate remote resync + ask customer to run with `--disable-chunked` (owner) 2) aj -> PR #482 review + add fast healthcheck (owner) 3) sophie -> confirm firewall + cert patch with netops & customer (owner) 4) leo -> standby for fallback local-registry steps and oncall handover 5) qa -> run smoke once registry green. I'll update the runbook and post final gate.
ramez: FYI I created a short diagnostic script to compare checksums: `./tools/checksum-compare --mirror https://mirror.harpoon.internal --src s3://harpoon-release` — sending to the customer now.
aj: Reviewed PR and left one minor comment about backoff jitter. Will resolve in next push.
sophie: NetOps confirmed firewall rule change request created (REQ-7097) and the customer said intermediate cert will be patched by 10:30 UTC today.
ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window for Harpoon tenant tomorrow 15:00-16:30 UTC. Notifications sent.
elisabeth: Perfect — looks like we're converging. If anything flips please update the runbook page and ping this thread. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
